data.text: Vibrant Student Life at The VIDYA School
A warm, nurturing home where underprivileged children discover their dreams, build lifelong friendships, and prepare to lead society.

items.title: The Four Houses
items.description: Agni, Prithvi, Vayu, and Jal houses inspiring healthy teamwork, sportsmanship, and leadership across all grades.

items.title: Nutrition & Wellness
items.description: Daily hygienic hot meals, pediatric check-ups, dental camps, eye check-ups, and clean RO drinking water systems.

items.title: Student Council & Leadership
items.description: Head Boy, Head Girl, house captains, and prefects actively participating in school governance and peer mentorship.
